4.name: Catty Neighbors Caught on Tape
4.overview: An animal advocate accuses her neighbor of destroying a habitat for nine feral cats. Frustrated with cats roaming his yard, he countersues for damages and harassment.

4.name: Spiritual Decluttering
4.overview: A spiritual healer accuses a former client of refusing to pay for house 'cleansing' services and of fraudulently reversing charges. The client fires back, calling her a scam artist who overcharged him.

4.name: Barking Up the Wrong Caliber and Promises, Promises
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  First, a tense encounter between a man's tiny hairless dog and an off-leash German shepherd husky escalates when the man pulls a gun for protection, leading to a $10,000 lawsuit over a false arrest.  Next, a woman sues her ex-girlfriend over unpaid personal loans, claiming she was deceived with promises of repayment. The ex countersues for harassment

4.name: Lies and Family Ties
4.overview: After their breakup, a woman sues her ex for stealing money and personal belongings. He countersues, accusing her of neglecting her younger brother and misusing funds meant for his care.

4.name: Mother's Judgement
4.overview: A young man sues his ex-convict mom for forging his name on a lease, leaving him stuck with a $10,000 debt and ruined credit. She denies responsibility, claiming he agreed to co-sign and blames him for the fallout.

4.name: Paco the Tank
4.overview: "Paco", the American bully, is caught in a tug-of-war between its owners, sparking accusations of theft and false restraining orders.

4.name: Husky Without a Cause and Grandmother's Trip No Go
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first, a man shoots what he thought was a menacing dog attacking livestock, only to discover it is a neighbor's visiting family pet.  Next, a grandmother sues her ex-daughter-in-law for trip expenses after her grandson was pulled from a Japan vacation at the last minute. The mother, amid a custody dispute, says she never approved

4.name: Diamonds Aren't Forever
4.overview: A mother claims her estranged son-in-law threatened her and took her granddaughter without permission and returning the child without precious diamond earrings.

4.name: Canine Crack-Up
4.overview: A man claims he was run over when a dog breeder reclaimed a Dalmatian he says was gifted to him. The breeder insists it was only a trial arrangement and accuses him of neglect that caused the dog severe injuries.

4.name: Sissy Fit and Abuse or Excuse?
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode.  First, a grieving widow, unable to stay in the home she once shared with her late husband, lets her sister move in. She now sues her for intentional damage and unpaid rent.  Next, ex-lovers sue each other for the $10K court max, disputing damages from their decision to move in together after dating for two months

4.name: Meow-ch
4.overview: A cat's tail has to be amputated after an alleged dog attack, leading pet owners to sue their neighbor for vet bills. The neighbor denies her huskies were responsible and blames them for letting the cat roam freely.

4.name: Here's the Kicker
4.overview: Video evidence captures a shocking moment at a friendly gathering, where one man claims his friend kicked him in the jaw, resulting in lasting pain. The friend says he was trying to break up a chokehold.

4.name: If It's Broke Don't Fix It and A Smiling Nurse
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first case, ex lovers with a child are locked in a dispute over unpaid lease balances and damage claims, with one party alleging domestic violence.  In the second case, after a severe motorcycle accident, a woman claims she lost income while nursing her ex-boyfriend back to health; he claims she owes for unpaid loans.

4.name: Keep Away Car
4.overview: A used car sale turns into a $10,000 legal fight over impound fees and parking tickets. The dispute comes to a head with a messy physical altercation over who owns the vehicle.

4.name: Make Your Bed and Lie in It
4.overview: After finding a hidden camera in her ex's bedroom, a woman sues him for assault and stolen property, while he fights back with a countersuit for defamation.

4.name: Portrait of a Vandal (1)
4.overview: In this two-part episode, a photographer takes her clients to court over a disastrous 21st birthday photoshoot, claiming defamation, slander and vandalism of her property.

4.name: Portrait of a Vandal (2)
4.overview: In part two, dissatisfied clients countersue their birthday photographer claiming she withheld photos and retaliated with revenge porn and threats, while denying any involvement in vandalism.

4.name: Stolen Emotional Support Cat
4.overview: A woman accuses her former neighbor of stealing her cat during her eviction. The defendant claims she rescued the neglected pet and nursed it back to health.

4.name: No Photos Please and Friendship Keyed out
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first case, a woman sues her ex-friend for posting and selling explicit photos of her on social media without consent.  In the second case, a young woman is accused of keying her friend's car but claims she has no memory of the event because she was under the influence of bad drugs.

4.name: Babysitter Battle
4.overview: A heated argument between exes over their child's babysitter escalates into violence: the father claims assault while the mother argues self-defense.

4.name: Doggy Trespass and Rescue Return
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode.  Up first, a dog owner claims her beloved pet was viciously attacked by a neighbor's German Shepherd while out for a walk, leading to expensive vet bills.  Next, a man claims he was sold a dangerous dog instead of the puppy he expected and demands a refund. The seller defends her rescue operation and insists the buyer mishandled the dog.

4.name: Tree Interrupted and Lotto Ladies
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first case, a woman sues a genealogy expert for unfinished research on her family tree.  In the second case, a decades-long friendship crumbles after a lottery win, with one woman demanding the entire prize and the other insisting on splitting it

4.name: Unlawful Ordination
4.overview: Rival officiants in the prison wedding industry accuse each other of slander and fight over defamation, lost wages and plagiarism.

4.name: Restraining Order Ordeal
4.overview: A father is suing his ex-partner for $10,000, claiming she falsely accused him of abuse and filed multiple restraining orders. She insists her actions were justified due to his threatening behavior.

4.name: Not So Smooth Criminal and German Shepard Jeopardy
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode.  Up first, members of a Michael Jackson tribute band clash over unpaid loans and costume ownership.  In the second case, rival dog owners battle for custody of a German Shepherd, with allegations of neglect and broken promises fueling their intense feud.

4.name: Defamation Association
4.overview: Accusations of slander, assault and a hate campaign ignite a bitter dispute between tenant association board members.

4.name: Keep On Truckin'
4.overview: After allegations of cheating, a man sues his ex-girlfriend for stealing property. She insists the items were gifts from their 14-year relationship and countersues for harassment.

4.name: Spicy Scuffle
4.overview: An educator claims her student's ex-girlfriend vandalized her car with a hot sauce bottle, causing significant financial losses.

4.name: The $10K Dogfight
4.overview: When a pit bull viciously attacks a service chihuahua, two brothers face off in court over responsibility and a $10,000 judgment-one claiming negligence, the other blaming the unleashed chihuahua for provoking the fight.

4.name: Ashes to Anguish
4.overview: Seeking $10,000 in damages, a grieving woman sues for emotional distress after her neighbor, whom she entrusted to take her beloved 17-year-old dog for cremation, instead buries him in a public park without her permission.

4.name: Sleepy Driving, Shaky Defense and Late Night Tow
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode.  In the first case, a driver falls asleep at the wheel, crashes into a ditch and admits negligence, but claims he owes nothing because the car was a gift from the plaintiff, not a loan.  In the second case, a co-owned car ignites a legal clash, with one party alleging illegal repossession and the other seeking an unpaid loan and towing fees.

4.name: Evicted Break In
4.overview: Evicted tenants are accused of breaking back into their rental home and vandalizing the property. They deny responsibility and blame poor property management and a crime-ridden neighborhood.

4.name: Funeral Funds Fallout and Rage Rampage
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first case, after their son's tragic death, a mother sues her ex-husband for $10K, claiming he broke his promise to use life insurance money to cover funeral expenses.  In the second case, after a heated confrontation, a landlord takes his former tenants to court, accusing them of vandalizing his property in a fit of rage

4.name: Cash for Claws (1)
4.overview: In part one of this two-part episode, a woman sues her neighbor, seeking $10,000 to cover her medical bills and emotional distress after being bitten by his service dog in his home.

4.name: Cash for Claws (2)
4.overview: In part two, the dog's owner fires back, accusing the woman of extortion. He claims she is unfairly demanding $10,000 for a minor wound and using the court system to manipulate him for financial gain.

4.name: Bitter Bloodlines
4.overview: After a violent clash, a man sues a family member for destroying his property, while the defendant countersues for harassment. Both claim emotional distress and challenge each other's version of events.

4.name: Marijuana Tales
4.overview: An in-home marijuana grow operation sparks a legal battle, with a landlord suing former tenants for violating the lease, property damage and costly repairs. The tenants countersue, claiming they left the house in pristine condition and are owed their security deposit

4.name: Tire'd and Toxic and Blame in the Ashes
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first case, after a birthday getaway, a woman accuses her ex of vandalizing her car and slandering her online; he claims she was cheating on him.  In the second case, the $10K court maximum is sought when a trailer sale goes up in smoke as buyer and seller dispute the fire's cause and missed payments.

4.name: Hit and Run Standoff
4.overview: A retired couple claims a driver hit their car, attempted to flee, and ghosted them after promising to pay for damages. The younger driver insists the crash never happened.

4.name: Bit in the Butt and I'm Not the Tooth Fairy
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  First, a man is bitten in the buttocks by a neighbor's dog and sues for medical bills, pain, and humiliation. The neighbor claims he was drunk, stumbled onto her lawn and fell on the dog.  Next, a man sues the mother of his child for defaulting on a loan for dental school. She argues repayment was impossible due to childcare costs after he went to jail.

4.name: Age Gap, Power Trap
4.overview: An aspiring police officer is sued by her older ex-boyfriend for thousands in unpaid personal loans. She counters that he was behind on child support and that their relationship was marked by years of abuse.

4.name: Spit Take
4.overview: A parking feud turns hostile when a man is caught on video spitting on a neighbor's car after arguing over a compact parking spot. She seeks $10,000 in damages for vandalism and harassment.

4.name: Mary Poppins Knockoff and Filial Grief Turned Property Beef
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  First, a young nanny is being sued for $10,000 after quitting abruptly and refusing to repay her employer for a car. She claims safety concerns over a new housemate with a troubled past prompted her sudden departure.  In the second case, a grieving mother accuses her late daughter's ex-boyfriend of withholding her belongings after a fatal car accident.

4.name: Bloodlines and Battle Lines
4.overview: After receiving a $10,000 signing bonus to enlist in the military, a woman sues her aunt for the same amount, claiming she stole her belongings while she served in the Navy.

4.name: Not Your Boy Toy
4.overview: A nurse sues her ex for $10,000 in unpaid loans; he claims the money was a gift given out of guilt for her alleged affair and fear of leaving him.

4.name: Snowboarder on Trial: Fast and Flurious
4.overview: A novice skier suffers a terrible accident and sues for $10,000 in damages after being knocked unconscious in a collision on a beginner slope.

4.name: Breaker Box Brawl
4.overview: A tenant sues his landlord for $10,000, claiming a staged video led to a wrongful arrest for assault. The landlord counters, claiming self-defense and blaming the tenant for the violent clash following an eviction notice.

4.name: Lost in the VR World and Barking Up the Wrong Tree
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  Up first, a friendly playdate turns nasty when an unsupervised VR gaming session ends in a broken television. Former friends blame each other for the mishap between their children.  In the second case, a dispute over a promised pit-bull puppy escalates when a neighbor accuses the other of filing a false CPS report and retaliation after a car incident.

4.name: Vengeance in Spray Paint
4.overview: A woman sues her ex for a loan to fix a car he claims is a "lemon" that he bought from her brother. He accuses her of vandalizing the car with spray-painted insults and punctured tires, then threatening him with a knife.

4.name: Slammed and Sabotaged
4.overview: A landlord claims her ex-roommate cut the electrical cords of her appliances. The roommate countersues, accusing the landlord of sabotaging her motorcycle, stealing her plants and leaving her without a home.

4.name: Seconds to Impact and Lose a Cruise
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  First, dramatic dashcam footage captures a Tulsa crash as drivers argue over a chaotic school drop-off.  Next, a 'free' cruise dispute intensifies, with one sister-in-law demanding cancelation fees; the other claims she was threatened at a bar over payback, allegedly triggering a seizure.

4.name: Mural Mishap
4.overview: A failed mural business venture sparks a lawsuit between two former friends who dated briefly, with one suing for a painting machine pay-off and the other for unpaid labor.

4.name: Ridin' Dirty
4.overview: After a heated argument during a dirt biking trip to Hawaii, a man claims his former friend vandalized his property in retaliation. Despite damning surveillance footage of the incident, the defendant denies all liability.

4.name: Longings and Belongings and Gramps Gone Rogue
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first case, a single mom fights to regain her belongings after her relationship with her live-in ex-lover implodes.  In the second case, a woman says her father stole her car, drove her young son, crashed it and bit her. He claims he left a note and she attacked him first.

4.name: Dog Decides Custody
4.overview: The fate of a Chihuahua is dramatically decided in court after a legal battle alleging theft and abuse, with both sides making emotional claims about its care and ownership.

4.name: Breaking and Entering…and Slashing
4.overview: A tenant's daughter is accused of slashing tires and scratching her landlord's car after a heated eviction dispute. She denies causing the damage despite security footage showing her near the vehicle.

4.name: The Boy is Mine (1)
4.overview: In this two-part episode, a man sues the mother of his 5-year-old son for $10,000, claiming she falsely accused him of assault, leading to his arrest and loss of custody. He alleges the incident occurred after he reported seeing bruises on their son while in her care.

4.name: The Boy is Mine (2) and Tag, You're It
4.overview: In part two, a mother of seven countersues for $10,000, accusing her ex of filing a false CPS report and assaulting her during a custody exchange.  In a second case, estranged parents clash over the sale of an SUV, leading to a stolen vehicle report and dueling lawsuits over damages.

4.name: Favorite Brother's Cop Out and Great Dane to the Rescue
4.overview: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode.  In the first case, a man sues his brother for totaling his car, claiming he promised to pay for the damages but bought himself a car instead.  In the second case, a rescue dog's fate hangs in the balance as animal lovers battle over defamation and life-saving surgery funded by a contested GoFundMe.

4.name: Drone Drama Saga
4.overview: A son's mission to fix his mother's valuable work drone is interrupted by his wife, who demands attention for their newborn child instead. She is sued by her estranged mother-in-law for mishandling and further damaging the drone during her failed attempt to get her husband's attention.

4.name: Vandalized and Vindictive
4.overview: A mother is suing her daughter for $10,000 in damages after discovering extensive vandalism at the apartment she offered her daughter and grandchildren as a temporary home. The daughter blames squatters for the damages.

4.name: Toddler Tango (1)
4.overview: In this two-part episode, a man sues the mother of his infant son for $10,000, accusing her of assault, theft and filing false police reports that led to his arrest and temporary loss of custody after a heated altercation.

4.name: Toddler Tango (2)
4.overview: In part two, a young mother countersues her ex for $10,000, alleging he assaulted her while she held their child, refused to return her belongings after their breakup and made false accusations to gain custody of their son.

4.name: Tools of the Trade and Broken Homes
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a landlord sues her former handyman-turned-tenant for damages, claiming he left her property in disrepair after multiple arrests, including one for harassing neighbors. In the second case, after serving time for neglect, a mother is sued by a former friend for failing to repay a loan used for legal services to regain custody of her children

4.name: Scheming Siblings
4.overview: Siblings clash over a BMW sale gone wrong, with unpaid money, hidden dings, and toll costs at the center of their contentious dispute.

4.name: Lineage Larceny and Some Expensive Teeth
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a disinherited woman sues her sister for $10K, claiming she stole their late father's life insurance money, while the sister countersues for slander and harassment. In the second case, a man sues his estranged daughter-in-law after spending $10K on her dental work. She claims an allegedly abusive marriage prevented her from repaying him

4.name: No Love Lost Landlord
4.overview: A retired landlord living in Vietnam is sued for $10,000 by his California tenant for illegal eviction and destroying her family heirlooms. In response, he countersues for $10,000 after being handcuffed during a citizen's arrest she made for alleged trespassing and assault

4.name: A Minor Issue and Parking Disaster
4.overview: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a man accuses a teen driver of running a stop sign and totaling his car; the mother and daughter insist he was speeding and triggered the collision. In the second case, a woman crashes into the side of her friend's house while parking and faces a lawsuit for costly damages. Her father defends her, arguing that both friends share the blame

4.name: Bait and Switch
4.overview: An Airbnb stay turns into a nightmare when a couple accuses their hosts of unsafe conditions and misrepresentation; the hosts fire back with claims of rule-breaking, property damage, and financial losses.

4.name: Shouldering the Burden
4.overview: A night out between exes turns physical when one claims the other caused a serious shoulder injury during an argument. She blames his boating accident for the medical bills he now wants her to pay.

4.name: Ex Roommates: Drama Unleashed
4.overview: A mother of three accuses her roommate of illegally evicting her after a brief and tumultuous stay, claiming she was forced to leave and her belongings tossed on the lawn.

4.name: Dinner in the Sky
4.overview: A dream Dubai trip disappoints when a promised "dinner in the sky" and other once-in-a-lifetime activities fall through. Disgruntled travelers demand payback from their travel agent.

4.name: The Jewelry Heist
4.overview: A woman claims her ex-boyfriend robbed her of thousands in jewelry after a violent breakup, while he counters that she took his possessions during his time in prison for the assault.

4.name: Night at the Oscars
4.overview: A glamorous Oscar party turns into a legal battle when the host accuses her ex-friend of keeping ticket money and helping organize a rival event.

4.name: The Kids Aren't Alright (Part 1)
4.overview: In this two-part episode, a teenager moves in with a family friend only to be sued for property damage, arson, and unpaid utility bills.

4.name: The Kids Aren't Alright (2) and Rumble in the Courtroom
4.overview: In part two, violence erupts when the teen is told to move out. She countersues for an unlawful eviction and damages from an assault by her family friends' two teen daughters. In a separate case, surprising details about a boxer's fight record emerge in court, as he's sued for a loan he promised to pay.

4.name: Mattress & Carpet Holdover and Baby Mama Jailhouse Drama
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in the episode. Up first, a neighbor comes to the aid of a mother in need by purchasing beds for her children; he expects repayment now that she's back on her feet. Next, a man who served two years for assaulting the mother of his children wants his dirt bike and Cane Corso dog back. She argues that the dog bonded with the kids while he was in prison

4.name: E-Bike Teen vs Senior Driver
4.overview: A 76-year-old driver is left shaken after a teenager recklessly turns and crashes his electric bike into her car. The teen's parents countersue saying she caused the accident that sent their son to the hospital.

4.name: Vacation Mayhem in Jamaica and Out of Control Chaos
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, an all-girls birthday trip to Jamaica goes off the rails when cousins and friends get into a series of drunken fights, damaging property and stealing items. In the next case, a once-close friendship turns violent when one woman accuses the other of wrecking her apartment, stealing her belongings, and trying to hit her with a car.

4.name: Father's Wheels, Son's Mess
4.overview: A father takes his son to court after a car meltdown leaves him holding the bill and liable for insurance.

4.name: Neighborhood Joyride Disaster
4.overview: When a woman's stolen car is destroyed in a high-speed chase, suspicion falls on her neighbor's minor son. Police bodycam footage comes into play.

4.name: Year of the Firecracker Incident
4.overview: A retired singer sues her ex-friend of 30 years, blaming his firecracker stunt for her hearing loss. He calls it a festive gesture gone wrong, not negligence.

4.name: When Motorcycles Fly and Swifties
4.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, an uninsured driver crashes into a motorcyclist, sending him flying and leaving him with severe injuries. The motorist denies fault and countersues, claiming damages to her car. Up next, after a rift, a Taylor Swift fan sues former friends for $10,000, rejecting their $300 refund and demanding the ticket's skyrocketed value instead

4.name: Exes and Oh No's
4.overview: A woman sues her ex, saying he attacked her during a messy Easter showdown, but he fires back, claiming she started it. Both sought protective orders, but only one was granted.

4.name: Crossing Family Lines and Home Is where Mom Isn't
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, a young woman claims her mother and brother refuse to give her the car they cosigned for; she demands reimbursement for travel and emotional distress. In the second case, a mother sues her daughter for moving costs and stolen belongings after a violent clash over a new apartment.

4.name: Nanny Nanny Boo Boo
4.overview: After working a grueling 24/7 schedule, a nanny sues her former employers for lost wages and a ruined reputation after a bad review. The couple blames her for bathroom mishaps and a broken toe, demanding their money back.

4.name: Four's a Crowd
4.overview: Roommates turn rivals as one sues for vandalism after being evicted, while the other claims his longboard and GoPro were stolen.

4.name: Lying in the Deep
4.overview: A woman says an ex-boyfriend took her money for a diving trip, bailed out of a second trip, and then ghosted her. He insists she canceled the trip and owes her nothing.

4.name: Double Dog Diss (1)
4.overview: In this two-part episode, a shared backyard turns into a battleground when one neighbor's dog bites the other's dog leading to a vet visit and a tenuous agreement to keep the animals separated.

4.name: Double Dog Diss (2)
4.overview: In part two, a heated argument escalates into yelling, kicking of dogs, and a frantic 911 call, ending with a neighbor being bitten. One side claims harassment forced them to move, while the other argues they caused constant trouble and were evicted.

4.name: Unfurnished Business
4.overview: A shared apartment and a fleeting romance ignite a legal fight over a stolen firearm, restraining orders, and missing property.

4.name: Feline Fight
4.overview: Felix the cat makes an appearance in court when his original owner demands his return. His ex says he waited too long and only took his Xbox and bongs when he left.

4.name: Dogged by Poison Claims and Stolen Hearts and Keys
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her roommate for negligently leaving out trash that made her French Bulldog, Gizmo, deathly ill. In the second case, a woman sues her ex for taking her car without permission and wrecking it, claiming he was on the run during probation and never paid the court-ordered restitution.

4.name: Foster Fallout (1)
4.overview: In this two-part episode, a foster mother claims her ex-foster child's girlfriend trashed her house in a rage. The teen, fueled by a lovers' quarrel, allegedly shattered windows with her scooter after a heated standoff.

4.name: Foster Fallout (Part 2) and Leasing Lunacy
4.overview: In part two, the accused teen denies causing any damage, alleging the foster parent broke her own windows. Eyewitness accounts from both current and former foster children come into play. In a separate case, a woman sues an in-law for the court maximum of $10,000 after leasing a car for her, only to face repossession and a devastating blow to her credit score.

4.name: Paw & Order: Broken Leg
4.overview: A dog's broken leg sparks a heated dispute between pet owners and a doggy daycare, with video evidence of a hose incident fueling accusations of reckless play versus a simple accident.

4.name: Vines and Fine Lines and Burning Bridges Over Burning Man
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman fights for her privacy after her beloved grape vine fence is allegedly destroyed by her neighbor. In the second case, artwork left exposed in a yard becomes the centerpiece of a legal battle between a gallery owner and her ex-friend disputing money loaned for a music festival.

4.name: LA Fire, Legal Fury and Fast and Furious Finances
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, after the LA fire, a woman sues her neighbor over car damage she found beneath the ashes; she's countersued for a false CPS report and harassment. In the second case, a longstanding brotherhood bond is broken after a car sale goes sideways

4.name: Funeral Funds or Fraud? and Beg, Borrow, and Steal
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a woman sells her deceased roommate's car to pay for his funeral; the car buyer sues her after being arrested for driving a 'stolen' vehicle. In the next case, a generous offer to help out a family in need spirals into a messy legal fight over stolen belongings, unpaid rent, and broken promises.

4.name: Flip Or Forever
4.overview: In a high-stakes house battle for the court maximum, a woman offers to buy out her ex and keep their forever home. He insists they were supposed to flip the $600K+ property for profit.

4.name: Spa Attack
4.overview: A facial meant to give a woman a 'glow' before a big event allegedly left her with permanent face damage. Spa owners countersue for a bad review and chocolate smeared on their window.

4.name: The Great Husky Heist
4.overview: A former dog rescuer with 80 huskies claims a woman stole five of his dogs after they got loose in Montana. She insists they were legally adopted and accuses him of defamation and online harassment.

4.name: I Was Late? Prove it! and While You Were Sleeping
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a friendship ends in a bitter dispute over a repossessed car fueled by missing money and mixed messages. In the second case, a woman hospitalized after a seizure returns home to find her landlord discarded all her belongings, sparking a $10,000 dispute over her eviction.

4.name: Blended Famiy, Bitter Ending
4.overview: After divorcing their spouses to form a blended family, former partners clash over repayment of a loan and shared Christmas gifts. Their breakup escalates into a physical dispute, contested as assault versus self-defense.

4.name: The Lot that Bit Back
4.overview: A jagged metal spike tears through a man's gas tank as he enters a private parking lot. The owners say it was city property and off-limits; the driver claims they still have to maintain the area.

4.name: Stepsister Showdown
4.overview: A family eviction leaves a woman accusing her stepmother and stepsister of illegally locking her out, assaulting her, and destroying her belongings.

4.name: Tools Down, Fists Up!
4.overview: A car repair dispute escalates into a violent parking lot confrontation, with one man suing for assault and unpaid fees. The defendant counters, claiming he was attacked first and had to defend himself from a weapon threat.

4.name: Cocktail Party Gone Wrong and Birthday Bait-and-Switch
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a festive networking event sparks a lawsuit after guests blame the host's unregulated bar and unsafe zipline for their injuries. In the second case, a birthday celebration turns sour when a woman accuses her party planner of secretly downgrading the venue and serving subpar food to her 50 guests.

4.name: The Dog Grief Exchange and Bailiff Breaks Up Car Clash
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, after her rare dog dies, a woman takes in a similar breed from an animal advocate--then sues, claiming she was misled into adopting a sick dog that cost her thousands. In the second case, a rental car, a missed job, and mounting tickets spark a yelling match that requires bailiff intervention to restore courtroom order

4.name: Inheritance Interrupted
4.overview: An inheritance ignites conflict when a woman cancels a rental partnership, allegedly leaving her half-brother unpaid for renovations.

4.name: Drunken Denial
4.overview: A woman accuses her intoxicated boyfriend of violently vandalizing her car, while he has no memory of the incident. Now, she's demanding repayment for damages and a repossessed vehicle she purchased for him.

4.name: Paws Off Our Property
4.overview: A bitter 30-year feud between neighbors escalates over accusations that one couple's Labrador viciously attacked their neighbors' miniature dachshunds, leaving serious injuries.

4.name: A Kick In The Teeth
4.overview: A man lands in the ER with a fractured tooth requiring nine stitches and multiple surgeries after a drunk friend knees him in the mouth. She partially pays for his medical expenses, then cuts him off, claiming he lied about what happened.

4.name: Protective Order Showdown and Sedan vs Scooter
4.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a dispute between former lovers escalates when a woman accuses her ex of filing a retaliatory protective order; he insists his actions are justified by the nearly 200 calls she made to him in a single month. Up next, a motorist sues an electric scooter rider, claiming he recklessly darted into traffic and smashed into his car.

4.name: Family Ashes Feud
4.overview: A grieving woman sues her estranged son for the return of her mother's ashes, sobbing in court as he refuses to return them. She also demands a necklace containing some of the ashes after claiming she was previously too emotional to keep it.

4.name: Knife To Know You
4.overview: A series of mysterious tire slashings spark accusations when a woman blames her former friend for the repeated vandalism. He denies the vandalism and alleges she stole money from his bank account.

4.name: Massage Table Meltdow and Breaking Up Badly
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a girlfriend's hidden cameras reveal her boyfriend's infidelity, leading to a heated confrontation. He sues for vandalism claiming she trashed his car in retaliation. In the second case, a tense breakup between former roommates leads to competing claims of harassment and a disputed restraining order over an alleged assault

4.name: Kitten Conspiracy
4.overview: A cat breeder accuses a customer of breaking their agreement by secretly planning to breed a rare Maine Coon kitten intended solely as a pet.

4.name: Helping Hands, Heated Demands
4.overview: A woman sues her niece for the $10K court maximum, claiming she spent that amount to support her while she stayed in town to help care for her dying uncle. The niece says the money was freely given in return for her caregiving.

4.name: Texting Under the Influence and Bad Bestie
4.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a Vegas trip between online daters ends badly when a woman demands repayment for gambling and travel; her ex says his promise to pay her back was just a drunken, emoji-filled text. Next, after a woman is kicked out of her best friend's apartment, she sues for $10K over an allegedly illegal eviction and defamation
